2. Use various tools for the statistical analysis
3. Formulate hypothesis for the research
4. Evaluate the performances different statistical tests for decision making

methods required for applied research. It also intends to enable research scholars to draw
conclusion based on the analysis of the data.

Course Outcomes
After completion of the course, the student will be able to -
1. Describe basic principles of statistical data analysis.
2. Use various tools for the statistical analysis
3. Formulate hypothesis for the research
4, Evaluate the performances different statistical tests for decision making
